notes.title: Mirror 2: Project X Official Trailer! With Surprises!
notes.notes:
[h3]Many of you may have known this, but indulge us to introduce to you: Mirror 2: Project X Store Page has been revealed! 

We’ve prepared a special Trailer for all our supporter, there’s a surprise in it, please don’t miss it! [/h3][previewyoutube=3ZZxoaI_gTc;full][/previewyoutube]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A side project of the Mirror Series – Mirror Party is now released in Early Access! There’s a discount and two promotions, check it now! 

[h2]Promotion One: Mirror Party Early Access Release Event[/h2]

Purchase Mirror Party before 11:59 PM, December 10, 2021 (UTC+8) and the playtime of Mirror Party exceeds 3 hours. Go to the website and click the big round button to participate. 

[h3]Prizes: 
        8 PlayStation 5
	50 Mirror Series Deluxe Merch Pack
	600 Mirror Series Merch Pack
	TONS of Steam Keys[/h3]

[h3]Promotion Webs: [url=https://activity.mirror-2.com/p/mirror_party_EA_release_event]https://activity.mirror-2.com/p/mirror_party_EA_release_event[/url][/h3]

[h2]Promotion Two: Mirror Thank-You Event[/h2]

Purchase Mirror Party before 11:59 PM, December 10, 2021 (UTC+8) and the playtime of Mirror exceeds 3 hours. Go to the website and click the big round button to participate. 

[h3]Prizes: One PlayStation 5[/h3]

[h3]Promotion Webs: [url=https://activity.mirror-2.com/p/mirror_thank-you_event]https://activity.mirror-2.com/p/mirror_thank-you_event[/url][/h3]
